title: Singing with Red in Germany: 'Do You Know What It Means to Miss New Orleans'
summary: His best singing came with Red Richards in Germany on an album called Sugar, after only novelty vocals with Fats.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Herman, did you do much singing?

Did I? Yes. Uh-huh. One of the best things I've ever done in my life I did with Red in Germany. "Do you Know What it Means to Miss New Orleans." I had the -- did the album here to -- in fact, the name of the album is Sugar.
Oh. But before you were with Red did you have much chance to sing? With Fats you couldn't do anything much, could you?
No, I could have, but I did -- I did do a couple of novelty things with Fats here and there, you
know. Oh, what the heck were they? Done one the other day. On -- on the wax here. Forgotten I'd done it.
With Charlie Johnson did you sing?
No, with Fats -- no, no. I didn't sing with Charlie Johnson. But I'll tell you a couple of things I did with Fats, but Red Richards, I did quite a few things, you know?
This was -- your best chance you had to sing.
